Question 1

Consider the straight line with the vector equation r=[2−37]+t[−52−1]

for t∈(−∞,∞). Find the Cartesian equation of this line.

a
 x+2−5=y+32=z+71
b
 x+53=y−2−2=z+17
c
 x+52=y−2−3=z+17
d
 x−2−1=y+32=z−7−5
e
 x−2−5=y+32=z−7−1

decision.explanation: The vector equation gives x=2-5t, y=-3+2t, and z=7-t. Solving each for t yields (x-2)/(-5)=(y+3)/2=(z-7)/(-1), which is option e.

Find 
$|\begin{aligned}1 & 9 & 0 \\ d & e & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 5\end{aligned}|$
given that 
$|\begin{aligned}1 & 9 \\ d & e\end{aligned}|=9.$

 E−1=[3−212]
